Asserts the CORRECT arc, not today's behaviour: two DISTINCT waiting episodes inside one antigravity turn — one raised by a mutating tool (write_to_file to /tmp, outside the workspace), one raised by a READ-ONLY tool (view_file /etc/hosts, outside the workspace) — because agy gates file access by LOCATION (FilePermissionInteractionSpec.BLOCK_REASON_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE), not by mutation. Both edges of each episode DO reach the file the daemon tails: the entry is a PLANNER_RESPONSE carrying an ask_permission tool call (live example: conversation c5609139 step 13, Action=read_file Target=/Users/ingo/.nvm) and the release is a MODEL/GENERIC step 'Permission for read_file(/Users/ingo/.nvm) was granted' (step 14, +7s). The parser turns them into an ordinary open/close tool pair, and nothing routes either edge to waiting: ask_permission is absent from session.isUserBlockingTool (metrics.go:501) and from isPermissionGatedEditTool (metrics.go:553), the parser never sets PermissionPending/TranscriptPermissionPending, and installedHookEvents is [Stop] only (PreToolUse deliberately excluded on the #1719 hazard). So gate_waiting_1, gate_answered_1, gate_waiting_2 and gate_answered_2 are all expected RED until ask_permission joins the user-blocking tool set and its tailer twin. Antigravity is a single-birth adapter (session id = the <conv-id> brain directory; the conversation dir and transcript are minted only AFTER the first prompt lands, hence the 30s birth window). INTERACTIVE recipe is mandatory: agy print mode auto-DENIES anything needing approval ('the %s tool(s) required approval that headless mode cannot prompt for, so they were auto-denied'). Cost and per-turn tokens are absent from the antigravity transcript, so both are asserted absent; model is left unpinned for record to fill.
